title: Great sounds, difficult interface
body: The sounds genuinely work very well for me — better than other similar apps I’ve tried. That’s the main reason I keep using Brain.fm. However, I find the app itself difficult and unintuitive to navigate. It’s not always clear what the different options do or how I’m supposed to use them, and I haven’t found an obvious place in the app that explains how to get the most out of it. I’ve tried other apps with much better and more intuitive interfaces, but their sounds didn’t work nearly as well for me. I’d love to see Brain.fm bring the user experience up to the same level as the quality of its audio.

title: Please, stop reminding me to enable notifications.
body:
The service is great but PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE stop reminding me to enable notifications every time I open the app.

Haven’t you thought that if I have disabled notifications I have a good reason for that?

This app is about focusing and relaxing, and notifications and reminders are the opposite of that, at least for mw. Use as many notifications as you want, but let me be without them.

title: Love it. Best 7€ spent so far in live
body:
Meditation: 
Left meditation 1 month ago due to some changes on life and routine, hard to come back, even more when you try to sit down for 20’. 
Use this app, within 10 minutes I was already in the zone, with other apps I needed 20 and sometime even more. 

Focus: I focus like never before in last 4-5 years. After 10 minutes of listening to it I get in the zone and nothing around distracts me, before I would get bored and check the phone or internet. 

Best 7€ I’ve spent so far.
